title: MiniMax H3 Day-0 Support in ComfyUI: Open Weights, Native Audio, and 2K Video
summary: ComfyUI announces day-0 support for MiniMax H3, featuring open weights, native audio generation, and 2K video output. This integration enables users to run advanced multimodal models locally, with a focus on accessibility and performance. The release highlights ComfyUI's role as a flexible framework for AI content creation.
